display_name: GloBE Top-Up Tax & QDMTT Allocation Calculator
purpose: OECD Pillar Two GloBE top-up tax calculator: per-jurisdiction substance-based income exclusion (SBIE), effective tax rate (ETR), and top-up-rate/top-up-amount, then allocates the top-up across QDMTT, IIR, and UTPR, applying the OECD Side-by-Side Safe Harbour (approved/declassified 5 January 2026) when the caller declares a Central Record listing of a Qualified SbS Regime, a Filing Constituent Entity election, and a fiscal year on or after 1 January 2026 -- when it applies, Top-up Tax is deemed zero for both the IIR and the UTPR. Ports the calculation from tools/473-globe-etr-jurisdiction-calculator.html and tools/474-topup-tax-qdmtt-calculator.html into one provable kernel. SBIE payroll and tangible-assets rates come from the OECD GloBE Model Rules Article 9.2 transitional schedule for fiscal years beginning 2023 through 2032 (Article 9.2 replaces the 5% of Article 5.3.3 and 5.3.4 year by year) and sit at the 5% steady state from fiscal year 2033; the payroll rate is overridable per jurisdiction and there is no assets-rate override; fiscal years before 2023 are refused fail-closed. Rates are pinned behind a constants_version field -- a rate change is a version bump, never a silent recompute. Jurisdiction-level QDMTT enactment/rate and the Central Record listing are caller-supplied, never vendored.
